title: More GPUs or a Smaller Cache? Tensor Parallelism versus KV Compression for Memory-Bound LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2608.23962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When an LLM serving deployment runs out of KVcache room, there are two well-established ways out. Tensor parallelism shards the weights and the KV cache across two, four, or eight devices, buying memory headroom at the price of an all-reduce on every layer and a hardware bill that grows with the device count. The algorithms community shrinks the cache in place, with KV quantisation and eviction keeping a single GPU and spending a little quality instead. Compression papers report memory ratios, parallel-scaling papers report throughput curves, and almost nobody puts the two on the same cost axis. We place tensor-parallel configurations (degree 1 to 8) and KV-compressed configurations (16/8/4-bit, keep-ratios down to 0.25) on one costnormalised axis, cost per million tokens against latency, using a profiled simulator calibrated on A100, A40, and H100 hardware, and we go looking for the cost-equivalence crossover. We do not find one. Across

translated_title: 更多GPU还是更小的缓存？张量并行与KV压缩在内存受限的LLM服务中的比较
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23962v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当LLM服务部署耗尽KV缓存空间时，有两种公认的解决方案。张量并行将权重和KV缓存分散到两个、四个或八个设备上，以每层全归约操作和随设备数量增长的硬件成本为代价换取内存余量。算法社区则选择就地压缩缓存，通过KV量化和驱逐策略保持单个GPU运行，以牺牲少量质量换取空间。压缩论文报告内存比率，并行扩展论文报告吞吐曲线，几乎没有人将两者放在同一成本轴上进行比较。我们将张量并行配置（度1到8）和KV压缩配置（16/8/4位，保留比率低至0.25）置于统一的成本归一化轴上，以每百万token成本对延迟为指标，使用在A100、A40和H100硬件上校准的配置文件模拟器，寻找成本等效交叉点。我们没有找到这样的交叉点。跨...
tldr: 本文通过统一成本轴比较张量并行与KV压缩在LLM服务中的性能，发现两者在不同成本水平下没有单一等效交叉点，而是各自在不同场景下占优。
en_tdlr: This paper compares tensor parallelism and KV compression on a unified cost axis for LLM serving, finding no single cost-equivalence crossover; instead, each approach excels in different scenarios.
